title: A large α: the first step overshoots
notes: α = 8 with r = 1 multiplies ΔW by 8. Adam's first step on B is the same size whatever α is, so its effect is 8 times larger and the loss goes up, from 16.00 to 16.97. Then training grows a smaller B (0.08 an entry instead of 0.64 with α = 1) and ends at 0.01 after 60 steps.
